svg.title: rear_A7_2hp_REAR_FULL_FROST_CLEAR_LETTERS
svg.desc: A7 provisional front artwork for the digital study; not an order file, not a fit approval. Rear face up; keep TOP at TOP. Already mirrored X=W-X. Black filled regions are ENGRAVE (frost). Clear omissions: IN/THRU letter strokes, hidden M2/rack seats and through-holes. Jack pocket floors are frosted too (frost after pocketing). Do not mirror again. No engraving depth or laser settings assigned.
